summary:
Project Operaphonic — Giving Earth a Voice

Operaphonic is an interactive scientific sonification platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Earth Information Jukebox. Our mission is to transform NASA's Earth observation data into an immersive, accessible, and engaging auditory experience.

By converting environmental measurements—including global temperatures, atmospheric conditions, precipitation, and polar ice coverage—into musical tones, rhythms, harmonies, and soundscapes, Operaphonic allows users to listen to our changing planet.

Through an intuitive, browser-based interface, users can explore NASA datasets, select scientific variables, adjust sonification parameters, and experience real-time audio representations synchronized with visual data.

Combining Earth science, signal processing, music, and interactive visualization, Operaphonic creates new opportunities for scientific education, accessibility, and public engagement.

Our vision is simple: Earth has a story to tell, and Operaphonic gives everyone a new way to hear it.
details: Operaphonic is a simple web-based interface that allows users to experience NASA Earth Data in terms of audio/sound effects. Coded in HTML5 with ChatGPT assistance.
